metadata.title: आदिवासी भाषा बोली को बचाने की चिंता | Revitalizing Tribal Language | NTRI
metadata.description:
The National Tribal Research Institute in Delhi recently organized a thought-provoking event, bringing together tribal thinkers, writers, and leaders to engage in discussions on critical issues affecting Adivasi communities in India. Among the various topics explored during this program, a significant focus was placed on the imperative task of revitalizing and preserving tribal languages.

Distinguished participants, including the esteemed Padma Shri awardee Prof. Janum Singh Soy, actively contributed to the discourse. I

During the event, the Main Bhi Bharat team had the privilege of speaking with Prof. Soy and several other participants, exchanging thoughts and insights on the preservation and revitalization of tribal languages in India. Their passion and dedication to this cause were truly inspiring.
